units.pilot_rule: the first 4 positions from pools 1 and 2 and the first 2 from pool 3 form the pilot and leave the order; positions 1 to 100 of the rest are counted, 101 to 105 reserves

pools.1: the 18 MultiLang units that passed every gate in the head-to-head's walk and never ran: its 10 reserves and the 8 that passed after stage 0 was drawn (its 12 stage 1 and 2 stage 0 units are left out)
pools.2: the 56 MultiLang rows the head-to-head's walk skipped only for the repository cap, walked through the same gates
pools.3: quick/laneb/tasks/swerebench-r3a4.json tasks created 2026-03-01 to 2026-05-31 (110), converted by the state machines harness's SWE-rebench part, with the object-level history check

units.order: newest created month first, then seeded by draw_seed within a month; positions count only units that pass every gate

tests_added.rule: the extracted change (before the strict reading) adds at least one line that is not blank and not a whole-line comment (trimmed text starting with // , /* or * in rust, java, c, cpp, csharp, go, js, ts; # in python) to a test file: a TEST_PATH match, a hidden-test-patch file, or, for rust, a line inside an in-source test module (TEST_MODULES) of the new file rebuilt from base; deleted files add nothing; planning paths never count

coprimaries: less code: paired log ratio of non-test lines on units both arms fixed, below 1
tests added: difference in share of sessions that added tests
sentence_family.holds: (1) Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 with ratio < 1; (2) and (3) each point difference >= -0.05 and 95% interval not wholly below 0

interim.at: half of Part S's units in order_seed run order: the first 50 O and 30 B2 units, all arms
interim.bounds: two-look O'Brien-Fleming, two-sided, at the alpha of each contrast's Holm step
deciding: s-gstack minus each pack, O and B
s-gstack-line: less-code ratio crosses and both no-harm criteria already pass
interim.other_parts: Parts P and L: no efficacy look; cap and gap stops only

pilot.cap_rule: a tenth of the arm's re-priced counted budget; the driver opens a pilot session only while the arm's settled pilot spend is under its cap; an arm whose settled spend reaches its cap before its pilot sessions all run is left out under R111
pilot.ceiling: no pack fixes 6 of 6 O pilot units where the known rate for the model is 80% or more

items.what: runner, Part L walk builder and the rebuild of parts S and P's units

unit_images: parts S and P rebuild each head-to-head unit's image from its frozen recipe and re-run the base oracle (3 base fail, 3 fixed pass) before use; both digests recorded; a unit that fails drops for every arm of both parts
